findings.message: 1 frame in the middle of a stream holds an Info header, probably where files were joined; players that only look at the first frame play it as silence. The first at 0x829.
The audio after the LAME tag of 1 frame no longer matches the tag's music CRC: it changed after encoding, as MP3Gain and other editors change it. The first at 0x829.
Sync is lost for 100 bytes at 0x9CA.
